1.t: How to Start a Dragon Academy
1.o: Dragons are still dragons, and as a result, they are causing mayhem in the Isle of Berk. Stoick is reconsidering allowing the dragons to roam freely on Berk. It is up to Hiccup and his friends to convince Stoick otherwise.

2.o: The peace with the dragons has put Gobber out of business, since his job was making weapons to fight dragons. Stoick asks Hiccup to help find a new job for him ... but unfortunately a change of profession does not seem to go well with Gobber.

3.o: The dragons unintentionally reduce Berk's food productivity by still scaring the living daylights out of the local livestock, and with the first winter storm coming, the dragon-riding Viking youths of Berk must try and familiarize the local animals with their Dragon companions.

4.o: Hiccup finds an injured baby dragon. Toothless does not warm up to the energetic newcomer and the baby's angry mother arrives looking for her lost son.

5.o: The Dragons are blamed for vandalism, and Hiccup tries to prove their innocence by forming a night patrol called the "Dragon United Monitoring Brigade" (DUMB), but not in time to prevent the dragons' banishment from the island. Hiccup begins to suspect that Mildew is responsible for the scapegoat.

6.o: Hiccup had discovered Mildew framed the dragons but has destroyed all evidence of it, therefore he must prove of their innocence in order to get them back. Meanwhile, Alvin the Treacherous of the Outcast Tribe are on the mission to raid the Isle of Berk in order to find and capture the "Dragon Conqueror".

7.o: Stoick is in need of learning how to ride a dragon, and he quickly insists on riding Toothless all the time. Meanwhile, a mysterious dragon has been attacking fishing ships.

8.t: Portrait of Hiccup as a Buff Man
8.o: After getting his picture painted with his father, Hiccup begins to fear that he is not Stoick's ideal son, so to prove himself, he and his friends set out on a treasure hunt that even Stoick had not been able to complete.

9.o: After Mildew poisons all the dragons on the island, he is forced to help Hiccup, Stoick, and Gobber find and capture the ferocious Scauldron in order to get the antidote.

10.o: The teens of Berk find a mysterious girl named Heather on Thor's Beach. While Hiccup and the other teens openly welcome the newcomer, Astrid's jealousy turns to suspicion when she notices Heather is taking an unusual interest in the Book of Dragons.

11.o: Heather's betrayal to Berk caused the Book of Dragons to fall into Alvin the Treacherous' hands, and Heather's imprisonment on Berk. In order to get the book back from Alvin, Astrid disguises herself as Heather and goes into Outcast Territory. Towards the end of her mission, Astrid learns and confirms Heather's true motives for helping the Outcasts.

12.o: Berk's annual festive sporting competition, the Thawfest games, is underway and all the teens are participating with the dragons for the first time in Viking history. Hiccup is determined to finally best Snotlout, who constantly gloats about being the reigning Thawfest champion, but Hiccup's successes begin to make him arrogant and boastful, much to Astrid's displeasure and disappointment.

13.o: Sudden lightning storms are endangering the residents of Berk and it is believed Thor is angry at the island. Mildew leads the superstitious villagers into blaming Toothless, "the unholy offspring of lightning and death itself", for the lightning, leaving Hiccup to find the true answers for Thor's sudden destructive anger.

14.o: A rogue dragon – a Whispering Death – shows up in Berk, tearing up the village. He's on a mission to find Toothless and settle a score. Despite Hiccup's efforts to help, Toothless insists on facing the dragon alone. But unlike their past battle, Toothless's inability to fly my prove to be his undoing.

15.o: Dagur the Deranged visits Berk to renew a peace treaty between the Berserkers and Berk, and the dragons are put into hiding to dispel rumours that Berk is training a dragon army. But when Ruffnut and Tuffnut begin to fight, their dragon, Barf and Belch, is left out of control. The Viking youths must bring the twins back together to control their dragon and avoid provoking Dagur to war.

16.o: Caught in a waterspout, Toothless' prosthetic tail is damaged, rendering him unable to fly and thus leaving him, Hiccup and Snotlout stranded on Outcast Island. The three must work together to repair the damage, overcome the rivalry between Hiccup and Snotlout and return home to Berk before they are captured by Alvin and the Outcasts.

17.o: When Hiccup discovers Trader Johann's ship was shipwrecked in a rumored haunted bog with a gift made for him by his mother, he will stop at nothing to retrieve it.

18.o: When Snotlout and the villagers mistake dragon eggs for gems that bring good fortune, Fishlegs, who is responsible for the eggs' discovery, must take a stand against Snotlout and reunite the eggs with their Changewing mothers before they destroy Berk.

19.o: During Berk's annual Bork week celebrations, Hiccup is granted access to Bork the Bold's private and personal archives. When he finds information and a map about an island inhabited by Night Furies within Bork's notes, Hiccup is determined to bring Toothless to his family.

20.o: Mildew has betrayed the Vikings of Berk and allowed Alvin the Treacherous to kidnap Hiccup and Toothless. Astrid and Stoick must rescue them from Outcast Island along with help from a new friend.

1.o: Certain that Alvin is planning an attack on Berk, Stoick institutes flight restrictions on the dragon academy. Hiccup, certain that Alvin will be using his newfound dragon-training knowledge to bolster his attack, forms a secret “Dragon Flight Club” in order to train the kids to defend Berk against Alvin’s dragon army.

2.o: When Meatlug accidentally ingests magnetic rocks, she becomes magnetic herself - causing destruction through the town, but ultimately helping the kids win a battle against the Outcasts.

3.o: The kids go on a dragon survival-training mission to Dragon Island, where they encounter Dagur, the Berserker Chief, who has become obsessed with hunting the Night Fury.

4.o: Hiccup discovers that the town's water shortage has been caused by the Outcasts' plan to hide Whispering Death eggs under Berk, which soon hatch and tunnel under the island, threatening the villagers.

5.o: Hookfang is losing his ability to catch on fire, and it's up to Snotlout, Hiccup and the others to find the lair of the Fireworm Queen, which may hold the only possible cure, before it's too late.

6.o: Hiccup must help Astrid face her fear of the terrifying Flightmare, a ghostly dragon that seemingly "froze" her uncle with fear, shaming her family name. With Fishlegs' help, they discover that there's more to the Flightmare than meets the eye

7.o: A Terrible Terror training competition leads to a heated rivalry between Fishlegs and Snotlout, allowing Alvin to kidnap Meatlug. The kids must use their newly trained Terrors to rescue their friend.

8.o: When wild dragons start overwhelming Berk, Hiccup and Toothless discover islands are disappearing throughout the archipelago. When Hiccup and Toothless investigate the cause, they then encounter the Screaming Death.

9.o: While searching for traps, Tuffnut, Barf and Belch get trapped themselves... and a forest fire is approaching.

10.o: When the dragon riders discover a frozen Skrill, a lightning-powered dragon revered by the Berserkers, they scramble to get it off Berk.

11.o: Tuffnut goes undercover to help the riders rescue a Skrill.

12.o: Snotlout becomes convinced he is dying, and leaves Hookfang to Gustav. But when he "miraculously" recovers, Snotlout takes his dragon back, and Gustav decides to get a dragon of his own and join the academy... whether they want him or not.

13.o: Hiccup and co. discover an injured Scauldron on the shores of Changewing Island. The kids must heal the dragon and return him safely to the ocean, before he falls victim to the elements, as well as the territorial Changewings.

14.o: Hiccup and Toothless return from a mission to find Berk mysteriously empty. They discover that the village has been overrun by Speed Stingers, a venomous non-flying dragon that has trekked across the frozen sea to Berk.

15.o: Hookfang and Stormfly quarrel while the town prepares for the harvest.

16.o: Berk has been plagued with a bad case of the Eel Pox. Hiccup, Toothless and the gang, along with Gothi, go gather the ingredients for the cure. There's just one problem; the final ingredient is an eel from Eel Island.

17.o: The mysterious theft of metal objects all over Berk reveals the presence of marauding Smokebreaths. Hiccup and Toothless soon discover that these dragons are the work of Dagur, in a plot to render Berk defenseless.

18.o: When three adolescent Thunderdrums attack the village, only Stoick's Thornado can bring chaos to order.

19.o: Snotlout is expelled from the academy; Alvin returns to Berk to make amends.

20.o: Alvin reveals he trained the Screaming Death to attack Berk and destroy the island's inhabitants and only Snotlout and Hookfang can save Berk before it's too late. Meanwhile Hiccup gets ready for a final fight against Dagur to save Toothless and end the barbarians invasion of Berk once and for all.

1.o: Sungnyang disguises herself as a man and works to free women who were sent to be Yuan concubines. King Wang Ko orders Sungnyang to get close to Wang Yu to lure him into an ambush.

2.o: Sungnyang reveals to the Crown Prince that there is a spy among them. Prince Togon is exiled to Koryo.

3.o: Sungnyang mistakes the Yuan Prince for a Yuan soldier. For the prince's protection, the Koryo King barricades the prince within the Koryo palace.

4.o: The Yaun Prince asks Sungnyang to teach him how to defend himself. El Temur plans a full-on attack on Daechong Island in order to kill the prince.

5.o: Sungnyang and Prince Togon continue their way to Kaegyong to find the Koryo King. Meanwhile, El Temur takes Koryo's palace under his command.

6.o: Yom falls for Sungnyangs trick and brings in Prince Togon's body into the palace. Prince Togon becomes conflicted about choosing to tell the truth or becoming emperor of Yuan.

7.o: The King of Koryo finds out that Sungnyang is a woman and tires to protect her from Tangqishi. Meanwhile, at the capital of Yuan, Tanasiri is taking lessons to be empress.

8.o: Sungnyang plots to take revenge on Emperor Togon during his wedding ceremony. The King of Koryo and Yom Byongsu are to duel to see who will be commander.

9.o: The Koryo King defeats Yom and takes command, but is given poor resources to prepare for battle. El Temur is enraged when he finds out that the Emperor has taken in a concubine.

10.o: The Koryo King leads his men to their first victory against the Turks. The Emperor makes Sungnyang a part of his retinue.

11.o: The Empress orders Sungnyang to feed Lady Pak a powder that will cause her a miscarriage. The Emperor further suspects Nyang of being Sungnyang.

12.o: Nyang is ordered to spread rumors that Lady Pak is faking her pregnancy. General Bayan disguises himself as Batolu, but runs into unexpected trouble on the battlefield.

13.o: Lady Pak is brought in front of the inquisition to be re-examined. Sungnyang receives a written promise to be let out of the palace, but gets caught by the Emperor.

14.o: Wang Yu brings victory with him to the Yuan Palace. The previous Yuan Emperor is said to have written a blood vow before his death and all are scrambling to find it.

15.o: Wang Yu comes up with a plan to infuriate El Temur, but needs Sungnyang to accomplish it. The Emperor challenges Wang Yu to a soccer match.

16.o: El Temur tries to find the one who sent the appeal. Wang Yu finds out that Sungnyang was the one to help and decides to not see her again.

17.o: The Emperor and the Queen Dowager ask Wang Yu if he is interested in marrying one of the princesses. The Emperor opens a shadow play for Yang but uninvited guests decide to join them.

18.o: The palace fills with rats and begin the curse of the late Khan. The emperor decides to actively search for the Blood Vow.

19.o: Wangyu and Yeonchul comes up with a plan to fake Yeonchul's death to find out who are loyal to him. Nyang tell the emperor that she does not want him to speak to her again.

20.o: Wangyu meets with the Dowager and wins her trust. Wangyu asks Nyang if she wants to be his Queen once he goes back to Koryo.

21.o: WangYu receives permission from the Regent to return to Koguryo to visit his "sick" father. Nyang and two others stay behind to look for Jukho to find the blood vow.

22.o: The emperor decides to hide injured Nyang in the pavilion so the regent's men cannot find her. Nyang's party is attacked by thieves while they were trying to help Nyang escape.

23.o: Nyang gives birth to a son with a unique dot on his feet. The emperor and Wang yu finds out about Nyang and plans their revenge against the empress.

24.o: Nyang is found by Bayan in Liaoyang province while she is being sold as a slave. Nyang discovers the blood vow and shows it to Bayan.

25.o: Nyang begins the selection process for the consorts as she fights through the obstacles the empress sets up. Wang Yu continues to find who is behind the counterfeit money.

26.o: Nyang becomes a consort and begins to fight with the empress with the support of other people from Koryo. Wangyu is fighting to stop counterfeit money from entering Liaoyang.

27.o: Nyang begins to teach the Emperor how to read and write every night by disguising it as a party. The empress decides to lock Nyang in the archives and give her an impossible task to finish.

28.o: Nyang begins her plan to take the empress' power away from her. Wangyu meets with Hukso to get Musong back by telling Hukso that he is the husband of El Temur's niece.

29.o: WangYu finds out about Nyang's situation from Tal Tal after they arrest Huksu. Nyang continues her revenge on the Empress.

30.o: Nyang and Wangyu finally meet together and go their own ways. Feisu finally completes deciphering the book they found in Huksu's house.

31.o: The Emperor speaks in front of El Temur and also shows him that he can read. Tal Tal brings the spies from Eagle House in front of the governors.

32.o: Nyang avoids the bullet from El Temur and makes another governer the culprit of the attempted assassination of the Prince. The Empress calls in Wang Yu and Nyang together for a drink.

33.o: Nyang and the Emperor survive the coup but the Emperor is shot by a poison arrow. Wang Yu gets stabbed in the process of helping Nyang run away from the guards.

34.o: The Emperor comes to save Nyang and her servants from being punished for the Emperor's injury. The Empress decides to use a curse to try and kill Nyang.

35.o: After Nyang recovered the talisman and broke the curse, El Temur begins to have nightmares. Wangyu begins to train the bums Wongjin brought as new recruits.

36.t: Eagle Group and the Blood Vow
36.o: Bayan begins his plan to go to war with El Temur and marches to the capitol. El Temur receives word from his men that his son is bringing Bayan and won the war.

37.o: Nyang is in the Ice Palace and calls everyone in to start planning to defend the Emperor while Bayan takes the palace. Wangyu complete's his job by opening the gate for Bayan's soldiers to enter.

38.o: The Dowager opposes Nayng becoming the empress and makes Bayan bring his niece to run Nyang out. The former empress was hanged from the square for the public to see.

39.o: Bayan Hudu becomes the new empress and Nyang continues the search for the secret funds. Wang Yu is also searching for the secret funds to help Nyang become the empress.

40.o: Nyang finally finds out about the secret funds El Temur has been collecting. Bayan announces to the Emperor that he wants to go to war and conquer surrounding countries.

41.o: Nyang and Wangyu begins their plan to remove the money from El Temur's house. Tal Tal finds out that he has been tricked by Nyang and rushes back to see the secret room empty.

42.o: Wang Yu returns to Koryo and takes command by refusing to provide for Yuan any longer. Bayan takes his men to war with surrounding countries and tries to take them over.

43.o: The Dowager and Bayan frames Wang Yu of selling explosives to enemy states of Yuan. Wang Yu is stripped of his title and dragged to Yuan by the prince and Tanguishi.

44.o: Kim Sunju comes right on time to save Wang Yu and his servants from being executed. The Emperor breaks the promise with Nyang and start to drink again.

45.o: The Empress finds out about Maha's secret about his birth by threatening Yon Hwa. Nyang tells the Dowager and Maha that she will reveal all the secrets soon.

46.o: Nyang runs to save Maha's life after finding out that he is her real son. Maha's true identity is revealed and he is kicked out of the palace.

47.o: Wang Yu visits Maha and decides that he is going to take him to Koyro and tell him everything. The Eagle House wants Yom Byung Soo to go see Bayan.

48.o: Nyang keeps the Emperor locked up in her room so that no one will know that he is awake. Bayan is sent to prison for trying to kill Nyang and her son Ayu.

49.o: Nyang is sent to the temple to repent for her sins and ask for forgiveness. Wang Yu sends all the grains he bought to the palace to distribute to the people.

50.o: Nyang finally becomes the Empress of Yuan and Wang Yu gains his throne. Nyang is trying to find out about the Eagle House and confiscate their assets.

51.o: The Emperor continues to drink Kolta's poison knowing that Kolta is the head of the Eagle House. The Dowager kills herself in front of Nyang by drinking poison.

3.o: A new player for Anna's affections and hand in marriage has come into play. While she sorts out this new monkey wrench in her life, a new robot is unveiled.

4.o: The perspective is altered, focusing on some of the mechanics that keep Godannar and the other mechs running.

5.o: As our main characters train, emotional turmoil mounts in Russia.

7.t: Sorrowful Song of the Plum Blossoms
7.o: A pair of pilots become closer and the strange plague that killed Max is identified.

8.o: Given the severity of the Insania Virus, Goh is forbidden from piloting.

9.o: Ken's long search is over.

10.o: With Goh's risks of succumbing to Insania rising, it's up to his wife, ex, and friend to defend Dannar Base as countless beasts strike.

11.o: Tetsuya takes command of the Base, Goh is missing from sick bay, and a new wave of enemies begin to converge.

1.o: Ike Evans, owner of Miami's most glamorous hotel, needs his 1958 NYE concert to be a smash. He makes a deal with mobster Ben Diamond to ensure success that threatens his life and family.

2.o: Ike Faces the disappearance of Mike Strauss while DA Klein attacks organized crime through Ike's law-student son. Meanwhile, Stevie Evans' affair with Lily Diamond heats up.

3.o: Ike tries to bribe officials to legalize casino gambling. An old friend visits Vera, and Ben wonders if his wife is faithful. Ike contacts his wealthy ex-sister-in-law for a favor.

4.o: Mike Strauss' body is seized, Ike reacts to a break-in, and Victor plots  to get his wife out of Cuba. Vera secures Jackie Kennedy for a charity  event but laments not having children with Ike.

5.o: Ike is determined to save Judi Silver  from Ben Diamond. Polaroids of Stevie and Lily surface. Vera tries  something new to get pregnant, Danny and Mercedes' bond grows, and  Klein's search ramps up.

6.o: Ben and Ike bet heavily on a boxing match and Vera receives another cancellation from Jackie Kennedy. Meanwhile, Danny receives photos intended for Stevie and the DA makes an important discovery.

7.t: Who's the Horse and Who's the Rider?
7.o: Things are going badly for Ike: Meg turns down his offer, he is caught lying to Ben and Klein shows him damning evidence. Meanwhile, Stevie's affair comes back to haunt him.

8.o: Lily and Stevie's affair becomes dangerous for them both and Judi finds herself in Klein's hands.. meanwhile, Mercedes and her father receive some bad news.

1.o: Ike's wife and son learn about his silent partners as they scramble to raise bail; Ben, fearing Ike will crumble under the pressure of the murder charge, offers unexpected aid.

2.o: Ike launches a risky plan to rid the Miramar Playa of Ben Diamond; Ben seeks permission to kill Ike; Stevie and Lily have a real date; Vera is threatened by Meg; Ben hosts a depraved Seder.

3.o: Ike goes to Cuba to retrieve Maria's ashes and set his plan to oust Ben in motion. Stevie is lured deeper into Ben's world. Stevie offers a chemical solution when Vera struggles with exhausting rehearsals.

4.o: Ike makes mob boss Sy Berman a risky offer - Havana for the Miramar Playa. Danny commits to Jack Klein and learns the truth about Ben Diamond. Ben ruins an arms deal with the Cubans, with tragic results.

5.o: Ike and Meg grow close as Meg uses connections to fight the gambling bill. Vera must face reality about her dancing future. Danny's world roils due to the busted arms deal. Ben makes Stevie an offer.

6.t: Sitting on Top of the World
6.o: Stevie's sex and booze-soaked deejay convention takes over the hotel. Mercedes makes a revelation to Vera. Ike's plot to fix the Cuban lottery begins. Ben seeks revenge in the wrong places.

7.o: Ike's deal to run the Havana hotels hurts his ties to Victor. Stevie starts a new job with Ben. Klein swears to destroy Ike as passage of the gambling bill nears. Sy Berman arrives in Miami.

8.o: Ike and Ben's future rests on the outcome of the gambling bill; Klein considers Ike's offer regarding the Butcher; the end approaches for Stevie and Lily; Vera is overwhelmed with grief.

1.o: 22-year-old Tess moves to New York City, without friends or a specific ambition. After an interview at one of the best restaurants, she's invited to train. She attempts to keep up while observing her new coworkers.

2.o: When Tess forgets her wallet at the restaurant, she goes back to discover what happens after-hours: shift drinks. Simone teaches her about the coding of our tongues, leading Tess to become even more enthralled by Simone.

3.o: Tess meets Serena, an alumna of the restaurant who married one of their wealthiest guests. Serena and Simone were best friends. To Tess, Serena has the perfect life. Simone teaches Tess not to believe everything she sees.

4.o: Tess has a day off and decides to go to Simone's apartment unannounced; after Simone invites Tess into her world, her abrupt expulsion leaves Tess lonelier than ever.

5.o: Tess arrives at the restaurant in high spirits, but soon realizes this is a night where everything will go wrong. Tess and Sasha embark on a drug-fueled night of adventure to burn off stress until the night takes a turn.

6.o: After partying until sunrise, Tess is not in an ideal state for her exam; the day’s events make her question if it is really worth it.

1.o: Howard takes his staff to learn where their food comes from. Tess learns information that makes her wonder whom she can trust.

2.o: Tess’ bad credit score reveals something about her past, and he gang tries to help. Sasha is accused when Santos’ new shoes go missing.

3.o: Maddie Glover, the restaurant's head chef, returns for a surprise menu tasting. Tess connects with a handsome guest. Will receives a surprising offer.

4.o: Tess has a mortifying sexual encounter with Omar. Sasha receives terrible news from home. A table makes a racist comment to Heather.

5.o: There's a retaliation when Howard decides to restructure the restaurant's tip structure. Tess learns more about Simone and gets closer to Jake.

6.o: Simone's ex-husband shows up in the restaurant and dredges up old feelings. Tess tries to figure out what, and whom, she really wants.

7.o: Tess and Jake take their relationship to the next level, causing tension with Simone. Ari feels abandoned. Will uses his power for a questionable purpose.

8.o: Tess learns the truth about Jake and Simone's past. She forms a plan to get everything she wants in the restaurant.

1.t: A Princess, an Elf, and a Demon Walk Into a Bar
1.o: Princess Bean already has the wedding day blues when a mysterious figure arrives, claiming he's her personal demon. Elfo hates his happy homeland.

2.o: How to get rid of an unwanted fiancé? Bean's plan involves a party barge and mermaids. King Zøg tries to make Elfo's blood into an immortality potion.

3.o: Sorcerio declares that demonic possession is behind Bean's drunken exploits -- and things look dicey for Luci when the king hires an eerie exorcist.

4.o: With the king away, Bean throws a wild party while Odval and Sorcerio gather their secret society for a ritual. But the night takes a surprising turn.

5.o: Banished from the castle by Zøg, Bean tries to work but has trouble keeping a job. Elfo encounters a bizarre pair of siblings living in a candy house.

6.o: Bean tries her hand at diplomacy after Zøg makes her ambassador to Dankmire, Oona's kingdom and an important ally for Dreamland.

7.o: Elfo lies to hide his feelings for Bean, but things get complicated when she tries to help him by sending the knights on a quest.

8.o: Elfo's been kidnapped! Bean, Luci, Sorcerio and the knights search for him, along with a magical pendant needed to complete the immortality potion.

9.t: To Thine Own Elf Be True
9.o: After he learns a surprising secret about himself, Elfo heads home to Elfwood in search of the truth.

10.o: As Dreamland celebrates an unexpected arrival while saying goodbye to a friend, everyday life is thrown into disarray.

11.o: Bean travels with Dagmar to her homeland, Maru, where she rescues an old friend and learns of a mysterious prophecy she's expected to fulfill.

12.o: Bean and Luci concoct a plan to resurrect Elfo. But he'll have to meet them in hell -- if he can get there. Zøg discovers a friend in frozen Dreamland.

13.o: Bean and her friends return to Dreamland but don't receive a warm welcome from Zøg. Oona inspires a lackluster band of pirates who rescue her at sea.

14.t: The Lonely Heart Is a Hunter
14.o: Bean dreams about her mother and finds mystical Maruvian symbols around the castle. Zøg falls for an unusual woman he meets in the Enchanted Forest.

15.o: With a health crisis in Elf Alley, Bean and Elfo make a dangerous journey to find an ancient cure while Luci scams sick elves at his new clinic.

16.o: Learning that the elves are starving because of Zøg's excessive taxes, Bean plans a heist with a passing band of circus performers to recover the money.

17.o: Despondent because Bean dislikes him and his mother's away, Derek makes friends with a slimy sea creature. Zøg tries to contract a rich man's disease.

18.o: While Zøg refuses to face his feelings about Dagmar's betrayal, Bean writes to deal with her pain. But she faces obstacles to sharing her work.

19.o: When a scientific man appears in Dreamland, he's regarded with suspicion. But Bean helps him escape and travels with him to a wondrous steampunk city.

20.o: With King Zøg incapacitated, Odval makes a power play, assisted by the Arch Druidess. Luci and Elfo try to help Bean.

1.o: Queen Dagmar interrogates the Dreamland townsfolk to find out who's hiding Bean's body. Meanwhile, Luci reconnects with his estranged father.

2.o: While Bean and the crew try to find a place to dispose of the body, King Zøg battles cops, robots and an angry mob to rescue his three sons.

3.o: After Malfus foretells an ominous prophecy, Bean and Mora travel to Steamland to reconnect with Zøg — but first they must decode a cryptic message.

4.t: I Hear Your Noggin, But You Can't Come In
4.o: Zøg, Bean and Mora search for a way into the Freak Show to free Derek, Bear Boy and Freckles. Then, Elfo and the crew elude a persistent Bad Bean.

5.o: Tormented by the mystery of his death, Elfo takes an ill-advised trip to figure out who shot him. Meanwhile, Luci hides Bad Bean's head from Satan.

6.o: In the forgotten city of Maru, Bean meets the Queen of the Crones, who encourages her to harness her new special power. Later, Elfo falls for a friend.

7.o: As the townsfolk prepare for war, Bean and Zøg land in the Twinkletown Asylum, where the princess makes a stunning realization about her destiny.

8.o: A battle between the Dreamland army and Dagmar's forces may spell disaster for Princess Bean, unless she can defeat her greatest foe: herself.

9.o: With the Crystal Caverns magic flowing throughout the kingdom, only Bean can stop power from falling into the wrong hands — if she can quit moping first.

10.o: With the fate of Dreamland hanging in the balance, a mother battles her daughter for beauty, power and immortality. But living forever comes at a price.

1.o: Yusaku Fujiki of Den City is a first year high school student who prefers to keep to himself as he is a hacker. Using the identity of Playmaker, he fights against the Knights of Hanoi to uncover the truth of his past.

2.o: Yusaku managed to capture the Mysterious Lifeform as he chases after the Knights of Hanoi. In order to defeat them, he logs into the VR Space network, Link VRAINS, as Playmaker. He commenced a Duel, holding the lifeform as a hostage. However, the lifeform predicted that "Yusaku can't win with his deck", and performed a certain action...

3.o: Yusaku begins to examine the information hidden in the Mysterious Lifeform. Meanwhile, after his Duel against the Knights in the network, he became famous as the hero who saved Link VRAINS. Learning that the lifeform is with Playmaker, SOL Technology sets up an operation to capture it...

4.o: The true identity of the Knight of Hanoi who suddenly appears is Go Onizuka, a Charisma Duelist. As the new hero of LINK VRAINS, Playmaker has stolen away some of GO's fans. In order to regain their support, GO challenges Playmaker to a Duel.

5.o: GO carries out his Duel in a manner similar to Pro-Wrestling, using Dueling as a means to entertain the audience. Playmaker seems to be interested in this playstyle, which is different from his calm and calculated playstyle. As if acknowledging GO Onizuka’s Dueling, Playmaker Summons "Decode Talker", despite taking a huge amount of damage. And thus, the two’s ace monsters clash!

6.o: Aoi Zaizen works as a Charisma Duelist under the alias Blue Angel in LINK VRAINS. In order to gain recognition from her brother, Akira Zaizen, she publicly challenges Playmaker to a Duel in LINK VRAINS. However, Playmaker did not respond to her challenge. Instead, the one who appeared before her is Specter, who has disguised as her fan!

7.o: Feeling that the Knights of Hanoi are behind Blue Angel, Yusaku decides to Duel her to find out her real intentions. However, Playmaker is gradually driven into a corner. Blue Angel’s strong desire to be recognized by her brother has fueled her Dueling, and she won’t hold back…

8.o: Due to Hanoi's program, Aoi Zaizen is now in a comatose state. 1.o: Just like his classmates, Hank wants to show off his Highbeam toy for Share Day. But Trash Truck helps him make a switch to share something special.

2.o: First position, toe points, lifts and pirouettes! Trash Truck learns it all as Olive's new dance partner at his very first recital.

3.o: Trash Truck meets a cute and curious toad during his morning routine and helps his new friend find a way back home to his family.

4.o: When Hank suddenly loses his voice, Walter and Donny fill a tin can with sounds from around town to make him a new one.

5.o: The friends chase a tiny lizard into a pretend prehistoric world — where Hank's a cave boy, Trash Truck's a mammoth, and lizards are dino-sized!

6.o: How high can a balloon float? After a fun day with a couple of balloons they bought in town, Trash Truck and Hank try to find out!

7.o: On a beach day with Hank’s family, Trash Truck catches a glimpse of life under the sea and makes a new friend even bigger than he is!

8.o: Trash Truck gets the "honk-ups" after drinking a whole bottle of grape soda, so his friends try every secret remedy to cure them.

9.o: Trash Truck and Hank use a toy spider to play pranks on their friends — but they accidentally cause some chaos with the neighbor’s cat!

10.o: A game of freeze tag goes downhill when Trash Truck and pals get distracted by a sparkly new phone and start fighting.

11.o: With Ms. Mona as a referee, Hank, Trash Truck, Walter and Donny compete in a series of games to see who gets to make a wish on a dandelion.

12.o: Grab the fishing poles, tackle box and a can of worms! Grandpa takes Hank and Trash Truck on a fishing trip and tries to reel in a big catch!

13.o: Trash Truck always collects every single trash can in town. But he’ll need Ms. Mona to help him fight off the ninja flies swarming his last pick-up.

14.o: When the family trash can goes missing from Hank's driveway, the friends collect all the clues to try and catch the trash can snatcher.

15.o: No one in town notices Trash Truck while he’s making his usual rounds. Luckily, Hank is always willing to play at the end of Trash Truck's workday.

16.o: When their ticket for free ice cream flies away, will Hank and Trash Truck lose their spot in line — and their shot at trying the shop's new flavor?

1.o: When Reyka is summoned to her abductor's parole hearing after twenty years of incarceration, traumatic memories return and send her on a path of self-destruction. Meanwhile, a series of murders are waiting to be discovered.

2.o: After Reyka and the police investigate the bodies that were found in the sugar cane fields, they suspect that they are dealing with a serial killer. Meanwhile, Speelman attempts to convince Reyka to retract her parole statement.

3.o: When Reyka is rushed to the hospital, her family finds out that she was burnt trying to save the life of a traditional healer. Before long, new evidence links the healer and his employers with the murders in the cane fields.

4.o: An important piece of evidence disappears causing Reyka to start suspecting her boss, Hector Zwane, and his son. Meanwhile, Speelman's game with Reyka intensifies, as he tries to manipulate her to find out Portia's address.

5.o: Nandi is attacked by the killer and is in critical condition. The evidence leads the police to a suspect, but Reyka believes they have arrested an innocent man. Meanwhile, a peaceful protest is set up outside the police station.

6.o: Nandi's family and colleagues are devastated by her tragic loss, while Reyka and Samuel are filled with guilt. Meanwhile, Soda -now a man on the run- is searching for help, while the Tyrone family experience a harrowing incident.

7.o: Reyka reenacts Soda's execution and makes a shocking discovery. Later on, a trap designed to help the police identify the killer backfires dangerously, while Speelman plays his sinister game to finally reach his ultimate goal.

8.o: Reyka finally closes the case and prepares to return to her normal life. However, Speelman's evil plan has reached its final stage, and Reyka will be forced to face her demons in order to battle him.

1.t: Jump at the Dump / Road Block
1.o: Jump at the Dump: Stinky & Dirty build Jumpy the Stunt Cycle a new venue to perform her stunt show. Road Block: On the day Stinky & Dirty meet they must move a boulder that falls into an intersection in Go City.

2.o: Mighty Night Stinky and Dirty light a tugboat's path through the treacherous river in the dark and lead them safely to the harbor. Water Ways Stinky and Dirty must figure out a way to travel across water in order to deliver a birthday present to Go City island.

3.t: Can You Dig It? / Dirty, The Garbage Truck
3.o: Can You Dig It? While digging a hole, Dirty's rear shovel is pinned under fallen dirt. He and Stinky must figure out how a garbage truck can dig him out. Dirty, The Garbage Truck When Stinky's hopper won't open, Dirty must help Stinky complete his trash pick-up route...using his shovel and dozer blade in ways he never imagined possible.

4.o: Running on Empty When Stinky and Dirty run out of gas, they must come up with clever ways to get across town to the gas station for a fill-up. Rolling Blunder When a trailer truck spills its load of bowling balls, Stinky and Dirty must figure out a way to collect them all and bring them to the Go City Bowling Alley.

5.t: Concrete Plans / The Art of Trash
5.o: Concrete Plans Stinky and Dirty accidentally mess up some wet cement and in an attempt to re-smooth it, leave their tire tracks behind. They find creative ways to fix it. The Art of Trash Stinky & Dirty clean up a vacant lot full of trash to make a park, but when they can't remove some large items, they turn the items into a trash sculpture instead!

6.o: Brave's New Siren Stinky and Dirty try to fix Brave's broken siren, but the fire alarm sounds and they have to make other loud noises to clear traffic and escort Brave to an emergency call. Demolition Dust-Up Dirty and the other construction trucks work together to build a road but their teamwork fails in a hilarious slapstick manner, until a shared music rhythm gets them all working in harmony.

7.o: Lost! When Stinky and Dirty get lost in a thick fog, they come up with new ways to "see" and use smell and hearing to successfully find their way home. Squeak When Dirty develops a squeak that keeps him and his fellow trucks awake, he and Stinky go in search of a solution and discover that while some sounds keep you awake, others are good for helping you sleep.

8.o: Landlocked When a landslide blocks the canal, Stinky and Dirty find a way to get Mighty the tugboat to travel on land, helping him deliver buoys to the harbor! Bouy Ya! When the buoys are blown out to sea, the big ships can't navigate into the harbor--that is until Stinky and Dirty use garbage to build new buoys to direct the ships away from danger, and safely into their slips.

9.o: Follow That Line! It's Race Day in Go City, but when the little truck painting the course line goes off track, so do Red and the racecars. Stinky and Dirty race to the rescue and help the cars find the line and get to the finish line. Seeing Red Stinky and Dirty try to get Red from the car wash to the auto show without getting dirty, ultimately building a car wash right beside the auto show!

10.o: Detour Chill the ice cream truck is headed to the park to deliver ice cream when he gets a flat tire and gets stuck under a low bridge. Stinky & Dirty help him to find his way on a complicated detour. Heat & Ice On the hottest day of the year, Stinky and Dirty help Big Ben deliver a giant Polar Bear-shaped ice sculpture to the ice rink, before it melts.

1.t: The Last Melon / Little Big Dirty
1.o: The Last Melon When Stinky runs out of melons, he and Dirty use resourcefulness to try make their own melons, only to realize (to Stinky's surprise) they can grow them! Little Big Dirty When Dirty believes he has to be bigger to do a job the way his giant friend Digby does, he and Stinky make some creative attempts at making Dirty bigger.

2.t: A Sweepy Surprise / Radio Free Stinky
2.o: A Sweepy Surprise Stinky and Dirty are tasked with bringing Sweepy to his surprise party, but getting Sweepy to follow them proves harder than they thought! Radio Free Stinky When Stinky can't find the cans he's supposed to pick up on his trash route, Dirty takes a bird's eye view to help locate them - but communicating the information to Stinky from far away is a challenge!

3.o: Scaredy Brave Brave is afraid popcorn, and Stinky and Dirty help him overcome his fear so that he can go to the movie theater to see Jumpy's Big Jump! Movie Makeover When the movie projector at the drive-in breaks, Stinky and Dirty learn how to "make a movie" for the disappointed audience.

4.t: The Never Ending Race / Unburied Treasure
4.o: The Never Ending Race Red doesn't realize that she's passed the checkered flag, and Stinky and Dirty must catch up to her to tell her that the race is over (and give her the winners trophy)! Unburied Treasure Dirty unearths a mysterious chest and he and Stinky struggle to open it, but nothing works until they come upon a "key" discovery.

5.t: The Stinky and Shmirty Show / Moon Chasers
5.o: The Stinky and Shmirty Show When Dirty is called away, Stinky decides that - instead of delaying a super fun day of planned activities with his best pal - he will create a substitute Dirty to hang with. Moon Chasers Stinky and Dirty see the moon on the horizon and decide to drive there, but "the road to the moon" is far longer than it appears.

6.o: Honk, You're It Stinky and Dirty play a game of tag and when other vehicles speed, float, and fly out of reach, our heroes must think of more resourceful ways to make their friends "it." Smash-a-lot Stinky and Dirty try and build a fort but Smash keeps accidentally knocking it down! Can they find materials that won't smash?

7.t: Seeing Eye Stinky / Rover All Over
7.o: Seeing Eye Stinky Dirty needs to replace a billboard but gets an inner tube stuck on his head and can't see! Now Stinky must be Dirty's seeing-eye truck so he can finish the job! Rover All Over Stinky and Dirty babysit Rover and take him to the top of the construction site to run. Rover goes down the elevator without them! Stinky and Dirty must get back down so they can reunite with Rover.

1.t: A Case of The Sputters / Smash Trash Crash
1.o:
A Case of the Sputters: Stinky gets a case of “the sputters” (think vehicular hiccups!), which causes his garbage to keep popping out of his hopper, so he looks for a “cure.”

Smash Trash Crash: When Stinky knocks over one of his trash piles the crashing sound attracts Smash. She wants to build a tower of trash but cannot resist the urge to knock it down.

2.o: Forklifted: When a forklift takes a crate containing Stinky’s favorite set of smelly old wheels, he and Dirty must find the crate among a shelf full of identical crates!  New Car Class: When Carry the car carrier breaks down, Stinky and Dirty help get his load of youthful New Cars to the car lot.

3.o: Soap Opera: Tanker Truck spills a load of soap at the car wash, and Stinky & Dirty are enlisted to clear away the thing they try to avoid the most… SOAP!  Rockin Rollin: Rollin’ cannot navigate the turns to do his job along Avenue Curlicue, so Stinky & Dirty help him find a way to roll along without driving off the curvy road at every turn!

4.o:
Sno Cone Sliders: Stinky, Dirty, and other trucks can’t get up the hill for a fresh sno cone treat from Chill because the hill is covered in ice!

Trading Wheels: Dirty wants a cool looking rock so badly that he trades his front wheel for it, but, as he resourcefully attempts to fix his driving ability, he soon regrets his decision.

5.o:
Down Under: Stinky and Dirty get stuck at the bottom of a construction pit and must find a creative way to get out!

Monster Breakthrough: When Stinky and Dirty accidently smash up a billboard featuring Monster Truck, they feel responsible and try to put the billboard back together!

6.o:
Fire Away: When a fire breaks out too far from a fire hydrant, Stinky and Dirty help Brave to get water to the fire so Brave can put it out!

Save Brave: In the aftermath of a forest fire, Brave is trapped in the forest by a mudslide caused by the firefight. It's Stinky and Dirty's turn to be heroes as they use resourcefulness to clear the road and save Brave!

1.o: "غالادريال" تضطرب عند ملاحظة دلائل على عودة شرّ قديم. "أروندير" يكتشف اكتشافًا مثيرًا للقلق. "إلروند" يتلقّى عرضًا لخوض مشروع جديد مثير. و"نوري" تكسر أقدس قواعد مجتمع الـ"هارفوت".

2.o: "غالادريال" تجد حليفًا جديدًا. "إلروند" يلقى ترحيبًا فاترًا من صديقه القديم. تُقدم "نوري" على مساعدة غريب، بينما يبحث "أروندير" عن أجوبة، و"برونوين" تحذّر شعبها من الخطر.

3.o: "أروندير" ينتهي به المطاف كأسير. "غالادريال" و"هالبراند" يستكشفان مملكة أسطورية. "إلينديل" يتلقّى مهمة جديدة. و"نوري" تواجه العواقب.

4.o: الملكة الوصيّة "ميرييل" يتم اختبار إيمانها، و"إيزيلدور" يجد نفسه في مفترق طرق، و"إلروند" يكتشف سراً، و"أروندير" أمامه خيار صعب، و"ثيو" يتمرد على "برونوين".

5.o: "نوري" تتشكّك في فطرتها، و"إلروند" يعاني من أجل الحفاظ على عهده. "هالبراند" يقيّم اختياراته المصيرية. وسكان "الأراضي الجنوبية" يستعدّون للمعركة.

6.o: "آدار" وجيشه يهاجمون "أوستيريث".

7.o: ناجون من جائحة يحاولون الوصول إلى برّ أمان. الـ"هارفوت" يواجهون الشرّ. "دورين" في حيرة بين اختيار الصداقة أو الواجب. "آدار" يفكّر في اسم جديد.

8.o: تحالفات جديدة تتكوّن.

4.o: As Jun-hee struggles to distinguish reality from her dreams, she receives an old diary that contains a shocking truth.

6.o: Si-heon finds himself attracted to the new Min-ju. The love triangle grows when he decides to come clean to Jung In-gyu.

7.o: Jun-hee tries to warn the boys of the approaching danger. Meanwhile, a horrifying event takes place at school during the night.

1.o: Shaan Sengupta, the night manager of Dhaka's Hotel Orient Pearl, gets embroiled in the arms-dealing world of billionaire Shelly Rungta for going beyond duty for a special guest.

2.o: Unable to recover from the incidents in Dhaka, Shaan agrees to a significant change that would have a domino effect on his and Shelly’s lives.

5.o: Shaan faces a crucial test, and Lipika's shocking discovery could change the course of her mission. As BJ creates trouble, where is GV?

6.o: Shaan executes a risky plan to avoid Shelly’s suspicions. Meanwhile, Lipika, Danish and their team fend off an attempt to bury their mission.

1.o: Four men conspire to break out of one of the most notorious prisons in American history. Three make it to the water's edge... but what happened to them when they left the island remains a mystery to this day.

2.o: Stuck in prison on life sentences, two men used engineering smarts and psychological manipulation of several prison employees to escape Dannemora Prison; Richard Matt and David Sweat executed one of the most involved escapes from an American prison.

3.o: El Chapo became one of the most notorious and murderous drug cartel kingpins in modern history. His audacious escapes from maximum-security prisons in Mexico became the stuff of legends. He is now in a US supermax prison in Colorado where he is remanded to this day.

4.o: Six men, led by the mastermind, Nuno Pontes, escaped Pittsburgh State Penitentiary by tunneling to freedom under the massive wall of the prison. They made it as far as Texas before being caught and returned to prison.

5.o: Allied prisoners used all kinds of forgery and engineering tactics to tunnel out of a German Prisoner of War camp. Almost all were caught, fifty were executed and three made their way to freedom.

6.o: Almost forty prisoners locked up in HM Maze prison for actions undertaken as members of the IRA, escaped in a food truck. Many were caught right away, some years later, and some were never seen again.

7.o: Timothy Vail and Timothy Morgan were murderers incarcerated at Elmira State Prison in Elmira, N.Y.;. Vail wanted to escape, so he engaged Morgan in his plan to dig through the ceiling and flee from prison.

8.o: James Earl Ray, confessed killer of MLK, was a notorious escape artist. His most audacious escape involved manufacturing a ladder made of plumbing pipe and going over the wall of the Brushy Mountain State Prison.

1.o: تبدأ المحامية "ليلى"، حديثة العهد بالعزوبية، بمواعدة الطاهي "فيّاز" الذي قابلته خلال عطلتها. فيما تتولى في العمل قضية طلاق رائد الأعمال "جيم مراتان".

2.o: تدرك "ليلى" أن لشخصية "جيم" ما هو أكثر مما تحاول زوجته إقناع نفسها به، فيما يقاطع حبيبها السابق "عمر" موعدًا فاخرًا لها مع "فيّاز".

3.o: بعدما يهجرها "فيّاز" بصمت، تتخذ "ليلى" خطوات لمسح أثر "عمر" من حياتها تمامًا... ما يدفعه إلى رفع دعوى للمطالبة بحضانة كلبهما "بادي".

4.o: تُسوَّى قضية الطلاق، لكن "جيم" يستمر في الحوم حول "ليلى". وينتهي حفل ليلة رأس السنة برحلة مفاجئة إلى المستشفى.

5.o: يُعيّن "جيم" الشركة التي تعمل بها "ليلى" للعمل لديه ويطلب منها تمثيله في مزاد للنبيذ. ورغم أن "ليلى" تحاول تجنبه، إلا أنها تجد نفسها منجذبة إليه في افتتاح فندقه.

6.o: تحتاج "ليلى" إلى عطلة للابتعاد عن كل شيء، فتنضم إلى لقاء عائلي تكتشف فيه أن زواج والديها ليس سعيدًا كما تعتقد.

7.o: يجتهد "عمر" للعودة إلى حياة "ليلى" ويكلّل ذلك بعرض زواج. ورغم قدرتها على تخيّل مستقبلها معه، غير أن تفكيرها منشغل بـ"جيم".

8.o: تبدأ "ليلى" بإدراك حقيقة الرجال الذين في حياتها... حتى في لحظة وصولها إلى نهايتها السعيدة.

1.o: Leyla gets a fresh start when she finally moves into her new home, but Ömer's temper gets the better of him when he lashes out at one of his own friends.

2.o: Defne experiences a tragic loss and reaches out to Cem for help rather than Seyyaz, causing him to question their relationship's sincerity.

3.o: Nil catches Leyla and Cem in a compromising position, splashing their scandalous relationship all over the news. Beliz decides to file for a divorce.

4.o: Sarp finds Ömer in a bad condition. Leyla begins to feel the worrying repercussions of being Cem Murathan's object of desire.

5.o: Murat spirals when he finds out about Esra's brief rendezvous with an old flame. Leyla takes an unexpected trip to visit her parents.

6.o: Beliz arrives at a New Year's Eve party with a surprise date, while Cem makes an unexpected gesture to get closer to Leyla.

7.o: Defne's manipulation creates distance between Cem and Leyla, while Leyla feels increasingly out of place in her new home.

8.o: Cem's real motives emerge as jealousy strikes once more. Defne's role proves more complex than initially apparent.

1.t: Putting It All on the Line
1.o: The Brothers face a tough decision between a pair of investors who have sunk all their savings into a flip gone wrong, and former spouses in a make-or-break financial position with hopes to convert their garage into an income generating unit.

2.o: The brothers must decide whether to back an overwhelmed investor that is quite possibly sitting on a goldmine or a flipping couple who secured an enviable property but don't know if they should renovate for higher resale or rental income.

3.o: Jonathan and Drew must choose between a rookie investor way in over his head and a widow who's been sitting for years on prime real estate, all while racing to help a previous investor get his triplex back on the market.

4.o: After helping a newbie investor sell her late husband's commercial space, Jonathan and Drew continue their backing by reinvesting her profits into a residential property to generate much needed income, but they only have 45 days to make it happen.

5.o: The Brothers must decide between two experienced investors with much to gain, and possibly lose. One is taking on a massive flip with enormous value. The other is betting on a sophisticated rental triplex with the potential to turn a major profit.

6.o: Jonathan and Drew continue to help a family business on the brink of financial ruin. Good intentions are no match for the family's overspending, so the Brothers must rein them in while helping them navigate one of the biggest and toughest builds to date.

7.o: The Brothers consider two very interesting proposals. One involves a pair of flippers with a shrinking budget and unusual reno plans, and the other is a family who discovered a rare find in Los Angeles with the potential for multiple income streams.

8.o: Jonathan and Drew help a previous investor finish their lucrative garage project. While waiting for inspections, they travel to Venice Beach to choose between experienced flippers taking on a duplex and a 21-year-old rookie's dream income property.

9.o: After choosing to back a 21-year-old rookie investor who bought a $1.35 million dollar Venice Beach vacation property, Jonathan and Drew face their biggest mentorship challenge to date as they oversee a renovation budget that's spinning out of control.

10.o: The theory that Jonathan and Drew know a winning horse when they see one is put to the test when they decide between a historic property investment and a two-story blank slate. Both are equally promising, yet neither offers the path of least resistance.

1.o: يعيش سائق تاكسي حياة مزدوجة؛ نهارا يختبئ خلف هوية مزورة هربا من ماضي لا يرحم، وليلا يمنح روحه للأطفال في مسرح للدمى، حيث يغني لهم بصوتٍ\ يحمل أوجاع السنين. تنقلب حياته رأساً على عقب حين تتدفق إلى مقعده الخلفي راكبة غامضة تحمل معها عطرا من الخطر وسرا مميتا. لقاء عابر يضعه فجأة في قلب جريمة قتل غامضة، ليجد نفسه مطاردا بين مطرقة العصابات وسندان هويته التي بدأت تتكشف، في رحلة للنجاة تغير مسار كل شيء.
كلير ممرضة بريطانية تعالج المصابين في الحرب العالمية الثانية، تنتقل بشكل غامض عبر الزمن إلى القرن الثامن عشر في سكوتلاندا. تلتقي بمجموعة من رجال الثورة السكوتلاندية من بينهم شاب مصاب يدعى جيمي.

2.o: تؤخذ كلير إلى قصر ليوخ، ويتصاعد شك سكان المنطقة بهويتها، وهي بدورها تقوم بالتقرب من جيليس دانكن. عندما يكتشف زعماء المنطقة خبرتها الطبية، تنتقل كلير من كونها ضيفة إلى سجينة.

3.o: تقوم كلير من خلال عملها في معالجة المرضى، بمعالجة طفل كانت حالته الصحية متدهورة للغاية. وتجد طريقة قد تساعدها في الهروب من القصر.

4.o: يأتي الوقت المناسب للهرب خلال حفلة ينظمها القصر. ولكن يتعرقل مخططها بعد لقائها مع دوغل وجيمي.

5.o: تنضم كلير إلى الماكينزي في جولتهم لجمع الأجور. ويقوم دوغل باستغلال جيمي ليحصل على شفقة السكان. تتذكر كلير بأن حدثاً تاريخياً مهماً على وشك الوقوع.

6.o: تقوم كلير بمقابلة الجنرال البريطاني، ولكن تضطرب الأوضاع مع وصول الكابتن جاك راندل. يستغل راندل الموقف لينفرد بكلير لوحده، ويضغط عليها للبوح بكل ما تخبئه.

7.o: تجبر كلير وجيمي على الزواج، ولكن يكتشف الاثنان أن كلاهما يكن مشاعراً للآخر. والآن كلير واقعة في صراع بين زوجها في العالم الآخر وزوجها في هذا الزمن.

8.o: يحاول فرانك العثور على كلير بكل طريقة ممكنة. وكلير تحاول التأقلم مع حياتها الزوجية الحالية.

9.o: يقوم جيمي ومجموعته بإنقاذ كلير من بين يدي جاك راندل. وفي القصر، تتصاعد بعض المشاكل السياسية التي من الممكن أن تؤثر سلباً على عائلة الماكينزي. وحبيبة جيمي السابقة تحاول استرجاعه.

10.t: By the Pricking of My Thumbs
10.o: يأمل جيمي بأن الديوك الجديد للمنطقة سيقوم بإلغاء المبلغ المطلوب على رأسه. في الوقت الذي تحاول فيه كلير إنقاذ طفل يتيم.

11.o: توضع كلير وجيليس تحت المحاكمة بتهمة الشعوذة. ينجح جيمي في إنقاذ كلير، ولكن كلير تكتشف سراً عن ماضي جيليس.

12.o: بعد اتحادهما من جديد، يتوجه جيمي وكلير إلى منزل عائلة جيمي في لاليبروخ. تتكشف أسرار قديمة، وجروح من الماضي تعود من جديد.

13.o: يشعر جيمي بالتشتت مع ظهور شخصية من ماضيه. وكلير تأخذ على عاتقها توليد أخت جيمي في الوقت الذي ينضم في هو وزوج أخته إلى مهمة حربية.

14.o: تنطلق كلير وجيني للعثور على جيمي. ولكن تعود جيني أدراجها بعد انضمام مورتاغ إلى كلير في المهمة. فيقوم الاثنان باستخدام أسلوب مختلف لإيجاده.

15.o: تنطلق كلير إلى سجن ونتوورث لإنقاذ جيمي، حيث تدور الأقدار ليقع جيمي في قبضة بلاك جاك راندل.

16.o: تضع كلير خطة محكمة لإخراج جيمي من السجن، ولكن الأذى النفسي الذي حل به يسيطر عليه تماماً.

1.o: بعد عودتها إلى عالمها، يتوجب على كلير التعايش مع حاضرها ونسيان الحياة التي تركتها.

2.o: الحياة في فرنسا ليست سهلة وجيمي يحاول يائساً التغلب على الماضي. لقاء مع الأمير تشارلز يقدم فرصاً مهمة.

3.o: تجد كلير العزاء في قدراتها العلاجية خلال تقدمها وجيمي في مخطط إيقاف كولودن. ولكن يأتي الماضي ليقف في طريقهما!

4.o: يقيم جيمي وكلير حفلة عشاء، سعياً لتأخير مساعي الأمير تشارلز. في هذه الأثناء تعلم كلير أن جاك راندال على قيد الحياة.

5.o: يحاول الثنائي إشعال النيران من جديد، وكلير ستواجه مصيراً جديداً. علاقة جيمي وكلير تحت الاختبار.

6.o: يستخدم جيمي وكلير أساليب الطبابة الخاصة بكلير لتساعدهما في مخططاتهما. تدرك كلير أن جيمي تراجع عن وعده.

7.o: يتم إحضار كلير إلى المستشفى لإنقاذ حياتها وحياة جنينها. يطلب الملك لويس من كلير إصدار الحكم على رجلين متهمان بقضية جدّية.

8.o: يقوم الثنائي بطلب مساعدة جد جيمي اللورد لوفات. وأما كولوم ماكينزي الزائر، فلديه مخططات أخرى.

9.o: يجتمع كلير وجيمي من جديد مع لاليبروك وماكينزي. يزداد الضغط على الثنائي مع صراع السلطة والحروب الشخصية.

10.o: مع ثقته بمعلومات كلير عن التاريخ، يقوم جيمي بقيادة الجيش إلى حرب مع البريطانيين.

11.o: يتم إرسال كلير والمجموعة إلى الشمال خلف قائد الجاكوبايت.

12.o: يحاول جيمي جاهداً تعذيب جيش الجاكوبايت، وكلير تقرر مواجهة أليكس راندال.

13.o: في المستقبل، تزور كلير الماضي وتطلع ابنتها على الحقيقة. وأما في القرن الـ18 فيحين وقت الحرب وجيمي يحاول المستحيل لحماية حياة من يحب.

1.o: ماضي جيمي يقدم له طريقاً للنجاة، وكلير الحامل تحاول التأقلم مع حياتها بعيداً عن جيمي.

2.o: جيمي يمضي قدماً في حياة العزلة، وجيوش البريطانيين يحاولون العثور عليه.

3.o: يدرك جيمي في السجن أن عدو قديم أصبح مسؤولاً، وبإمكانه تدمير حياته.

4.o: جيمي يدخل إلى حياة عائلة بريطانية نبيلة.

5.o: روجر يحضر لكلير بعض المعلومات المهمة، والتي تجبرها على اتخاذ قرار مصيري.

6.o: بعد الانفصال لمدة أعوام طويلة، كلير وجيمي يجتمعان من جديد.

7.o: بعد مواجهة عنيفة، تحاول كلير اتخاذ قرار طبي، قد يعرض حياتها وجيمي إلى خطر.

8.o: تعود كلير إلى لاليبروك مع جيمي، ولكن لا تلقى الترحيب الذي كانت تتوقعه.

9.o: يتوجه جيمي وكلير إلى سكوتلاندا، في مهمة مصيرية.

10.o: تحاول كلير السيطرة على داء انتشر على متن سفينة.

11.o: بعد أن سلمت للأقدار، ينتهي المطاف بكلير على جزيرة نائية.

12.o: تصل السفينة أخيراً إلى جامايكا، حيث يقترب جيمي وكلير أكثر وأكثر من هدفهما.

13.o: تدخل كلير في صراع مع الوقت في محاولة إنقاذ شخص عزيز عليها.

1.o: كلير وجيمي يقابلان ستيفان بونيه، قرصان ومهرب يطلب منهما المساعدة. كلير تُحدث جيمي عن بعض أمور من التاريخ الأمريكي.

2.o: كلير وجيمي يزوران العمة جوكاستا بمزرعتها في ريفر رَن. عندما تقع مأساة في المزرعة، يجد جيمي وكلير نفسيهما عالقَين بين ما هو صحيح، وبين قانون الأرض.

3.o: جيمي وكلير يبحثان عن مكان ليكون منزلهما. في هذه الأثناء، في القرن العشرين، تشتعل العلاقة الرومانسية بين بريانا وروجر.

4.o: بعد أن قادتهم العناية الإلهية إلى فريزر ريدج. جيمي وكلير والشاب يانغ إيان يبدؤون ببناء منزل لهم في سلسة الجبال الزرقاء.

5.o: مهارات كلير الطبية تصبح في منتهى الأهمية، لكنها تخاف على حياتها بعد وقوع المأساة في منازل مرضاها.

6.o: جيمي وكلير يقعان تحت مفاجأة وصول اللورد جون غرِي إلى فريزر ريدج وبصحبته شخص آخر.

7.o: بريانا تتبع خطا والدتها وتسافر بالزمن إلى القرن الثامن عشر في اسكوتلاندا.

8.o: بحث روجر الدؤوب عن بريانا يؤتي ثماره عندما يجدها في ويلمينغتن، لكن لم شملهما العاطفي يتوقف عندما تكتشف أنه أخفى معلومات عنها.

9.o: بينما تصارع بريانا لتتخطى الصدمة التي تعرضت لها في ويلمينغتن، تصب تركيزها في العثور على والديها.

10.o: جيمي وكلير يخفيان الأسرار بعضهما عن بعض، فيما يساعدان بريانا بالتعامل مع الصدمة التي تعرضت لها مؤخراً.

11.o: بينما ينطلق جيمي وكلير والشاب يانغ إيان في رحلة طويلة لإنقاذ روجر، تقيم بريانا صداقة بينها وبين أحد أصدقاء جيمي القدامى.

12.o: يصادق روجر أحد الأسرى أثناء سعيه للهرب من قرية موهوك، بينما يخطط فيرغس ومارسالي لمهمة خطيرة.

13.o: تتعثر خطة جيمي وكلير والشاب يانغ إيان لإنقاذ روجر من خاطفيه، من الموهوك، عندما يظهر شبح من ماضي كلير.

1.o: تخمد الأجواء الاحتفالية في فريزر ريدج بأمر من شخصية سياسية ذات نفوذ، وحقيقة صادمة يكشف النقاب عنها.

2.o: بدعم من وحدة الجنود، يواصل جيمي مطاردته لمورتا وجماعته. عندما يموت مستوطن في ريدج بسبب مرض خطير، تشعر كلير بأن عليها اتخاذ الإجراءات اللازمة.

3.o: يقوم جيمي وكلير بمساعدة عبد لإنقاذ شقيقه التوأم من شر سيده، ولكنهما سرعان ما يكتشفان بأن الأمر أصعب مما تخيلاه.

4.o: يقود روجر ميليشيا جيمي إلى محطة براونزويل التجارية، ولكنه سرعان ما يجد نفسه في مأزق.

5.o: يصل جيمي والميليشيا إلى هيلزبورو، ويكتشفون بأن تايرون قام بتقديم حل غير تقليدي للتعامل مع تهديدات المنظمين.

6.o: في يوم زفاف جوكاستا، يصبح جيمي على علم بأن تهديدات الهيئات التنظيمية لا تزال مستمرة، فيما تكتشف كلير معلومات عن عدو من الماضي.

7.o: يصل تمرد المنظمين ذروته، الأمر الذي يجبر جيمي على مواجهة مخاوفه وعواقب ولائه المقسم.

8.o: يبدأ أفراد عائلة آل فريز بالتعافي من الأحداث الصادمة التي شهدوها خلال معركة ألامانس. لاحقا، يصل ضيف غير متوقع إلى ريدج.

9.o: يلتف سكان ريدج حول جيمي الذي يصارع من أجل البقاء. لاحقا، يكلف جيمي روجر بمهمة ليقوم بتنفيذها في حال وفاته.

10.o: تفشل خطة جيمي للقضاء على الخطر الذي يهدد عائلته. تجد بريانا نفسها مجبرة على الصراع من أجل حياتها وجيمي.

11.o: كشف كبير عن جيمي يجبر بريانا وروجر لاتخاذ قرارات مصيرية.

12.o: تكافح كلير للتعايش مع قسوة خاطفيها، فيما يتخذ جيمي تدابير صارمة في محاولة منه لإنقاذ زوجته.

1.o: يواصل جيمي وكلير القتال لحماية من يحبان، بينما يلوح تهديد الحرب الثورية فوق فريزر ريدج.

2.o: يعاني جيمي مع طلبه الأول كوكيل هندي. يترأس روجر جنازة غير عادية.

3.o: يقلق فيرغوس بشأن نوعية حياة ابنه الجديد عندما يتعرض الطفل للسخرية والتنمّر من البروتستانت المؤمنين بالخرافات. كلير تجري جراحة على يد توم.

4.o: يكشف إيان لجيمي حياته بين الموهوك. جيمي يخبر شيف بيرد شيئاً يجب عليه التفكير فيه، مستقبلاً.

5.o: هناك شيء ما في الجو. جيمي واللورد جون يتحدثان عن السياسة. روجر يتلقى أنباء ممتازة.

6.o: ينتشر وباء (الزحار) في منطقة ريدج، وتصاب كلير بمرض مميت.

7.o: تعاني كلير مع مخاوفها الداخلية، حين تبدأ شائعة شائنة بالانتشار على ريدج.

8.o: ريتشارد براون ولجنته للسلامة يصلان لاعتقال كلير بتهمة القتل.

2.o: A family dinner destroys everyone's appetite. Tension between Álvaro and Bárbara gives Iker what he needs.

3.o: Tequila, gossip and conflicting stories lead Bárbara further into a family mystery.

4.o: Álvaro encouraged Iker to bond with Bárbara, but not to this extent. Exploring Fernanda's room breeds conflict.

5.o: Confronting Iker seems right until forbidden desires take over — and Álvaro's suspicions alight.

6.o: The ultimate faux pas sets Margarita on the warpath. Álvaro's nightmare reveals a frightening declaration.

7.o: Bárbara's sure she's getting closer to the truth. She won't get it, though, if Gaby has anything to say about it.

8.o: An intimate scene in the woods and an ultimatum push Bárbara away from Iker. A slip of the tongue yields a new clue.

9.o: Passion fuels Iker and Bárbara, and a mistake rings alarm bells for Luna. Gaby's façade begins to fracture.

1.o: ما إن وصلت لويس إلى بيلروز حتى فقدت كل شيء: حبيبها وشقتها. ولعدم وجود مكان آخر تلجأ إليه، انتهى بها المطاف بالسكن مع لاين أونيل، وهو طالب يتمتع بشعبية واسعة لكنه يحيط نفسه بالغموض؛ فقد أسس لاين، بالتعاون مع أقرب أصدقائه، تطبيق سائقو الحرم الجامعي لخدمة النقل التشاركي المخصصة للطلاب. غير أن وصول لويس، بالتزامن مع عودة آرون إلى الحرم الجامعي، سرعان ما يهدد بزعزعة حالة الهدوء السائدة.

2.o: في بيلروز، تبدو الأمور وكأنها تسير على نحو خاطئ بالنسبة إلى لويس، حتى إن منحتها الدراسية باتت مهددة بالضياع. ورغم ذلك، فهي عازمة على البقاء، وتجد الدعم والمساندة لدى كل من بيكا وكاري وهوب وبرودنس، مما يساعدها على استعادة ثقتها بنفسها تدريجياً. غير أن العيش مع لاين يثير تساؤلات جديدة؛ فبين الغرفة الغامضة المغلقة وعودة آرون، تهدد الأسرار المحيطة بـ لاين ذلك التوازن الهش الذي نجحا في بنائه.

3.o: تبتعد لويس تدريجياً عن ماكس وتقترب أكثر من لاين، حيث تبدأ رابطة حقيقية بالتشكّل بينهما؛ إلا أن فضولها بشأن ماضي لاين يهدد علاقتهما الهشة. وتُشير عودة والدة لاين، التي تكلّفه بتنظيم حفل الخريجين، وتصاعد التوتر مع آرون إلى أمر واحد: ماضيه على وشك أن يفسد حياته.

4.o: يتلقى لاين، الذي يقضي عيد الميلاد وحيداً، دعوةً لقضاء العطلة مع عائلة لويس في الجبال. وبعيداً عن بيلروز، تكتسب العلاقة بينهما بُعداً جديداً؛ غير أن عودة ماكس غير المتوقعة تعكّر صفو هذا التقارب المتنامي وتُدخل مشاعر لويس في حالة من الاضطراب.

5.o: يخلق التقارب الجسدي بين لويس ولاين شعوراً بالحرج بينهما؛ فبينما تتردد لويس في المضي قُدماً نحو استقلاليتها، يجد لاين نفسه متعثراً تحت وطأة ضغوط والدته التي تفرض عليه اصطحاب آرون إلى حفل العشاء الخيري. وحين تتغلب آلام جراح لاين عليه، تجد علاقتهما نفسها أمام اختبار حقيقي.

6.o: بعد أن أصابها الألم، تعيد لويس توجيه تركيزها نحو مستقبلها وتتحول إلى دراسة الطب، مُبقيةً مسافةً تفصلها عن لاين رغم اعتذاراته. وفي غمرة شعوره بالندم، ينكفئ لاين على نفسه، لكنه يقرر السيطرة على مصيره من خلال كتابة قصته بنفسه. ويصبح الحفل الكبير مسرحاً لانكشاف الحقائق، حيث يتحرر لاين أخيراً من قيود ماضيه ويُظهر الحقيقة للنور.
